It does not model a transition system, algorithm, protocol, or fault-tolerant behavior; instead it is a simple value-level specification over natural-number arithmetic by extending Naturals. The file contains no variables, actions, temporal specification, fairness conditions, or proofs, and it simply establishes a derived expression from the declared constants.
